articles.summary: PSB Holdings just posted Q3 2026 results and the stock slipped 2.4% on the day, yet earnings per share of US$0.95 quietly set the tone. Traders focused on the red on the screen. The report instead highlighted a bank still generating net income of US$3.8 million in the quarter and a trailing P/E of 14.4x that already prices in a premium to many peers.
